scope: All project data; empty internal/test cohort excludes nobody; excludes later audit pageview

queries.sql: SELECT event, count() AS events, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS persons FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00') GROUP BY event ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT event, min(timestamp) AS first_seen, max(timestamp) AS last_seen, count() AS events, countIf(properties.$session_id IS NOT NULL) AS with_session, countIf(properties.browser_context = 'browser') AS browser_context, countIf(properties.project_id IS NOT NULL) AS with_project, countIf(properties.environment IS NOT NULL) AS with_environment FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00') AND event NOT LIKE '$%' GROUP BY event ORDER BY event

SELECT properties.$host AS host, count() AS pageviews, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS persons FROM events WHERE event = '$pageview' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00') GROUP BY host ORDER BY pageviews DESC

SELECT properties.$ai_span_name AS span, properties.$ai_provider AS provider, properties.$ai_model AS model, count() AS calls, countIf(properties.$ai_is_error = true) AS errors, sum(toFloat(properties.$ai_input_tokens)) AS input_tokens, sum(toFloat(properties.$ai_output_tokens)) AS output_tokens, median(toFloat(properties.$ai_latency)) AS median_latency_seconds, countIf(properties.$ai_input IS NOT NULL OR properties.$ai_output_choices IS NOT NULL) AS with_content FROM events WHERE event = '$ai_generation' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00') GROUP BY span,provider,model ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT properties.$ai_span_name AS span, properties.$ai_error AS error_class, count() AS events FROM events WHERE event = '$ai_generation' AND properties.$ai_is_error = true AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00') GROUP BY span,error_class ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT event, count() AS events, countIf(properties.proposal_id IS NOT NULL) AS with_proposal_id, count(DISTINCT properties.proposal_id) AS distinct_proposals, countIf(properties.edited_before_accept IS NOT NULL) AS with_edit_flag, countIf(properties.edited_before_accept = true) AS edited, sum(toFloat(properties.proposal_count)) AS generated_proposals FROM events WHERE event IN ('proposal_generated','proposal_accepted','proposal_rejected') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00') GROUP BY event

SELECT properties.$lib AS library, properties.$exception_handled AS handled, count() AS exceptions FROM events WHERE event = '$exception' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00') GROUP BY library,handled

SELECT event, count() AS events, countIf(notEmpty(JSONExtractString(properties, '$session_id'))) AS with_session, countIf(JSONExtractString(properties, 'browser_context') = 'browser') AS browser_context, countIf(notEmpty(JSONExtractString(properties, 'project_id'))) AS with_project, countIf(notEmpty(JSONExtractString(properties, 'environment'))) AS with_environment, countIf(notEmpty(JSONExtractString(properties, '$ai_trace_id'))) AS with_ai_trace FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00') AND (event NOT LIKE '$%' OR event = '$ai_generation') GROUP BY event ORDER BY event

SELECT count() AS calls, countIf(JSONHas(properties, '$ai_total_cost_usd')) AS with_total_cost, countIf(JSONHas(properties, '$ai_input_tokens') AND JSONHas(properties, '$ai_output_tokens')) AS with_token_counts, countIf(notEmpty(JSONExtractString(properties, '$ai_trace_id'))) AS with_trace, sum(toFloat(properties.$ai_total_cost_usd)) AS recorded_cost_usd FROM events WHERE event = '$ai_generation' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00')

SELECT properties.extractor AS extractor, properties.trigger AS trigger, count() AS passes, sum(toFloat(properties.proposal_count)) AS proposals FROM events WHERE event = 'proposal_generated' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00') GROUP BY extractor,trigger ORDER BY passes DESC

SELECT DISTINCT arrayJoin(JSONExtractKeys(properties)) AS property FROM events WHERE event = '$ai_generation' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00') ORDER BY property

SELECT count() AS outcomes, count(DISTINCT properties.proposal_id) AS distinct_proposals FROM events WHERE event IN ('proposal_accepted','proposal_rejected') AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00')

SELECT count() AS calls, countIf(JSONHas(properties, '$ai_input') OR JSONHas(properties, '$ai_output_choices')) AS with_prompt_or_output FROM events WHERE event = '$ai_generation' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-08-29 00:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-09-28 15:40:00')
